style: Cute rounded 3D clay style mobile game art, soft lighting from the upper left, bright clear colors, no outlines, no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no people.
sprite: Exactly one object, centered, fully visible and not cropped, seen from the front and slightly above, only a faint soft shadow under it, transparent background.
scene: A wide game background with only sky, distant scenery and ground. No houses, trees or other large objects. The horizon where the ground starts is at about 57% from the top. The lower ground area is fairly flat and empty so objects can be placed on it.
